title: A group adds leak shapes as data and may replace the leak scan as extension point leak_scan, and every replaced guard is named by kbext.py guards and kbmon --status
goal: The settings layers' leak.shapes (each a kind and a regular expression, refused at load when it does not compile or matches the empty string) are added to the shapes kbcommon.leak_hits and kbpublic.file_hits refuse, so a group's own ticket or host shape stops a commit, a publish and a contribute. extensions.leak_scan names a function with file_hits' signature that replaces kbpublic.file_hits in this clone. kbext.py guards --root WS prints each replaced guard with its module and layer (none: one line saying the shipped guards run), kbmon.py --status all names a replaced guard on its first lines, and git.md and extending.md say which paths still run the shipped guards (the gate on this story).

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir(); g=d/"group.json"
g.write_text(json.dumps({"leak":{"shapes":[{"kind":"ticket","pattern":"TKT-[0-9]{6}"}]}}),encoding="utf-8")
code="import sys; sys.path.insert(0, \"_tools\"); import kbcommon; print(kbcommon.leak_hits(\"see TKT-123456 for the change\"))"
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",code],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,KB_GROUP_SETTINGS=str(g)))
assert r.returncode==0 and "ticket" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
(e/"grp_scan.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\ndef file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=()):\n    return []\n",encoding="utf-8")
g.write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"leak_scan":"grp_scan:file_hits"},"extension_paths":[str(e)]}),encoding="utf-8")
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py","guards","--root",str(d)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,KB_GROUP_SETTINGS=str(g)))
assert r.returncode==0 and "leak_scan" in r.stdout and "grp_scan" in r.stdout and "group" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)

gates.question: When a group replaces the leak scan, do kbgit.py contribute and the shared repository's own gate still run the shipped leak scan and guards on what the group gives back?
gates.reason: a group's trust covers its own repository, not what it hands to everyone else; the shared gate never loads a group's extenders
